To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a post buckled composite panel can be tailored to exhibit a snap through response to external loads.
the design of adaptive, shape changing structures is facilitated by the use of a taxonomy of postbuckling modes and that the design concept of a morphing air inlet is viable.

the design principles of post buckled morphing air inlets are: 1) to exploit the instabilities and nonlinearities of the post buckling behaviour of composite panels to create adaptive structures that change geometry in response to external pressure fields and 2) to use the structural nonlinearity to create snap through mechanisms that enable the inlet to switch between "open" and completely "closed" states.
